senses.gloss: m. (שול, cmp. שַׁבְּלוּל; v. שַׁלְשֵׁל III) [slimy substance,]

units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 51">Gen. R. s. 51</cite>, beg. <he>כש׳ הזה שהוא נמחה בצואה</he> like the secretion which is dissolved in the excrements, v. <cite ref="K00539"><he>כִּילּוּיָא</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Rosh Hashanah 24b:7">R. Hash. 24ᵇ</cite> <he>מתחת לרבות ש׳ קטן</he> ‘beneath’ (<cite ref="Exodus 20:4">Ex. XX, 4</cite>) this includes the smallest earth-worms.

<cite ref="Tosefta Chullin 2:18">Tosef. Ḥull. II, 18</cite>; <cite ref="Chullin 40a:2">Ḥull. 40ᵃ</cite> <he>השוחט … לשום ש׳ וכ׳</he> if one kills an animal in the name of mountains … or even of a small worm, such are ‘sacrifices of the dead.’ <cite ref="Chullin 67b:14">Ib. 67ᵇ</cite> <he>כל לרבות הש׳ והרומה לש׳</he> ‘whatsoever’ goes up on the belly (<cite ref="Leviticus 11:42">Lev. XI, 42</cite>), this includes the snail and whatever is like it (worms); Sifra Sh’mini, Par. 10, ch. XII <he>השִׁלְשׁוּלִים</he> (pl.).

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 8:13">Gen. R. s. 8</cite>; <cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 14:9">Lev. R. s. 14</cite> <he>ש׳ קדמך</he> the worm has been created before thee (man); a. e.—Pl. <he>שִׁלְשׁוּלִים</he>, <cite ref="U00069"><he>שִׁי׳</he></cite>, v. supra.
